title: Kinney's Hall and Janers in Newark
summary: He gives the name and street of Kinney's Hall in Newark and says the war started and his girl left him.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And, when was this? This was in Newark, New Jersey?
And when was this? Was this right after you left --
Yeah. Right after I left Brown.
I went up there in Newark, you see.
And what was the name of the place? Do you remember?
Oh, Keeney's Hall. But he didn't play at Keeney's Hall. He played at a place called Janers. Janers. Keeney's Hall, I played in Keeney's Hall later.
K - i - n - n - e - y - s.
Kinney's Hall. That was Arlington and Augustus. That's remembering pretty good, now. That was in 1917. Arlington and Augustus was where this place was, see.
Um hunh. This was during the war.
And I remember when I came back to Atlantic City, afterwards. I come back to Atlantic City. The gal [girl] I had, she done gone off with somebody else. I didn't have no girl.
No. I'd left Josephine a long time ago. Man, I'd had four or five since Josephine.
